derivation: For each measured normalized maximum E > 0, limit = 2**ceil(log2(E)). This rounds the observed maximum up to the next binary boundary; it is an empirical fixture envelope, not a universal analytic GPU error bound. Exact identity paths have zero tolerance.
host: Proposed R6 SatComp-node envelope on these fixtures, frozen before host access. Characterize CST/export errors separately; do not silently widen on failure.
